purpose: Preview supplementary information for a genuine navigable link.
avoid: Essential information needs an available non-hover route.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: The family presents controls or navigation; static depictions do not establish an interactive contract.
sourceRule: HoverCard wraps PreviewCard. Its content is a plain div, not a fabricated dialog or tooltip role; full information remains available at the link destination. Content defaults side=bottom, sideOffset=4, align=center, alignOffset=4. The reference lab explicitly sets delay/closeDelay to 0 to exercise the same source interaction promptly.
keyboardAndFocus: The actual PreviewCard Trigger is an anchor. Hover and focus use its configurable delay (600ms default) and closeDelay (300ms). Escape/outside press dismiss. There is no modal focus trap, and native Enter still follows the link rather than committing a preview selection.
referenceDecisions: One stable trigger/content ownership relation per shown instance; concrete labels and task children are caller supplied. Exact wrapper types retain optional handles/payloads/placement overrides. Complete describes this sufficient reference, not a full application/platform certification.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: Actual HoverCard portal positioning, collision handling and defaults remain primitive-owned; CSS does not recreate anchor coordinates. Native radius/insets are adopted as semantic popup metrics, while width is fluid with an explicit bounded maximum. HoverCard keeps native 10px corners, 12/16px insets and 272px maximum; the real trigger remains an anchor and essential profile information is available outside the hover card. No invented Title/Description exports or automatic dialog role.
